body.name: \(\Phi_{1,n}\) and \(\Phi_{2,n}\)
body.construction:
Put \(\nu_*=(2M_e^{1/q_e})^{-1}\) and \(c_*=1/2\).  For \(j\in\{1,2\}\), start from
\[
 \widetilde\Phi_{j,n}=\left\{t\mapsto\sum_{\ell=1}^{M_n}w_{j\ell}e^{itu_{j\ell}}:
 \begin{array}{l}
 w_{j\ell}\ge0,\quad\sum_\ell w_{j\ell}=1,\quad
 -H_n\le u_{j1}\le\cdots\le u_{jM_n}\le H_n,\\
 \sum_\ell w_{j\ell}|u_{j\ell}|^{q_e}\le M_e,\quad
 \displaystyle\inf_{|t|\le\nu_*}\left|\sum_\ell w_{j\ell}e^{itu_{j\ell}}\right|\ge c_*
 \end{array}\right\}.
\]
Set \(\Phi_{1,n}=\widetilde\Phi_{1,n}\) and
\[
 \Phi_{2,n}=\left\{\phi\in\widetilde\Phi_{2,n}:
 \left|\sum_{\ell=1}^{M_n}w_{2\ell}u_{2\ell}\right|
 \le2M_eH_n^{1-q_e}\right\}.
\]
The protected-frequency constraint exposes the common nonvanishing region used by analytic inversion.  Zero-weight atoms are placed at \(H_n\), and the ordered atom vector is selected lexicographically, which removes representation ambiguity without centering \(U_1\).
